revenueProvenance.basis: Issuer consolidated revenue, including contracts with customers and leases. GP is the issuer subtotal after cost of sales, hotel/gaming operations and direct property-leasing expenses; costOfRevenue aggregates exactly those above-GP costs. No synthetic gaming-tax gross-up.
revenueProvenance.operatingIncomeBasis: No operating subtotal is printed. Derived as the complete sum of revenue and all non-finance statement lines (PBT plus finance costs); includes property fair-value changes, other income/gains and impairment as reported. This is not recurring hotel EBITDA.
revenueProvenance.businessScope: Hotel and property-leasing operations. The official FY2026 report states that the SJM service arrangements terminated and Grand Emperor Hotel gaming area ceased operations effective 31 October 2025; FY2026 revenue is not a full year of the former casino operation.

annual.notes: Gaming ceased 2025-10-31, not re-presented as a discontinued operation on this income statement; substantial disposal/property valuation items remain in reported results.

limitations: 0296-hotel-gaming-leasing-gaming-in-continuing-operations links FY2023-FY2026 and September 2022-2025 H1. Note 1 of the 2023/24 interim explicitly reverses the earlier discontinued classification and re-presents September 2022 gaming within continuing operations, consistent with the March 2023 annual basis. No gaming turnover is grossed up. The October 2025 cessation is not an IFRS5 re-presentation on the latest FY face, so its in-year cessation does not itself invalidate FY2026-minus-September-2025 H1.

Earlier pre/post-HKFRS16 and old discontinued presentations remain separate where a cross-frequency bridge has not been certified. A common current group certifies compatible reported accounting scope, not unchanged gaming economics or recurring income.
All eight provider annual and sixteen provider H1 periods are covered. Official year end is March and H1 end September, not calendar December/June.
FY2021 comparative digits in the FY2022 PDF use a private-use font; decoded actual glyph digits from the original PDF, not blank comparative values from the manifest's plain extraction.

D&A includes release of prepaid lease payments before HKFRS16 and right-of-use depreciation after adoption. The H1 2010 comparative uses explicitly separated continuing depreciation 45844 plus prepaid-lease release 3223, excluding discontinued depreciation 82.

Operating income is derived, not an issuer-reported subtotal. Finance costs include financing-related amortization where reported. GP remains meaningful as the reported subtotal but is not solely food/beverage gross margin.

Gaming cessation changes business economics without a discontinued-operation re-presentation on FY2026's face. Do not extrapolate historical casino margins to the remaining hotels or equate a compatibility tag with unchanged business mix.
